title: Uniform and Typewriter
author: Ulyana Sandoval
blurb: Tamsin Quintana, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
